outputs.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - Panel A is a schematic diagram/table of breast cancer classification with no plotted data or error bars.
PASS - Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating study aims; no quantitative data or error bars present.
PASS - Panel C is a schematic illustration of the experimental method (luciferase recording); no error bars present.
PASS - Panel D shows illustrative example traces/schematics of analysis approaches, not real quantitative data requiring error bars.
PASS - Panel E is a schematic example correlation heatmap illustrating the method, not real data with variability to depict via error bars.
PASS - Panel F shows a schematic illustrative growth curve example, not actual replicated data requiring error bars.
PASS - Panel G shows a schematic illustrative dose-response curve example, not actual data with error bars.
PASS - Panel H is a schematic illustrating the genomic analysis workflow (heatmap/mutation matrix icons), not quantitative data with error bars.
PASS - Panel I shows example schematic scatter/cluster plots illustrating the concept of subtype definition, not real data requiring error bars.
